name: labs/knerlab__sim_control_software
title: Motorized polarizer (knerlab SIM/AO microscope)
intro: Motorized polarizer (knerlab SIM/AO microscope), adapted from knerlab/sim_control_software. It reads `position`; runs `move_absolute` and `stop_motion`. `move_absolute`: command one or more actuated joints to target positions in joint space, optionally over a declared duration, and report whether the target was reached within tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
